Scanning progress state with glowing radar line animation
Discovered subscription suggestions (e.g. Amazon Prime ₺39/mo, YouTube Premium ₺57.99/mo, ChatGPT Plus $20/mo)
One-click 'Aboneliklerime Ekle' action for auto-detected items
Filter by category (Eğlence, Müzik, İş/Yazılım, Bulut Depolama, Oyun, Spor)
Search bar with live filtering
Sorting by price, name, renewal date, payment method
Status badge (Aktif, İptal Ediliyor, İptal Edildi, Yenilenecek)
One-Click Cancel Button (Tek Tuşla İptal) opening provider's direct cancellation page in new tab
Direct CRUD: Add Subscription modal, Edit modal, Delete with confirmation dialog
Displays direct cancellation URL for chosen service (e.g. netflix.com/youraccount, youtube.com/paid_memberships)
Step-by-step cancellation instructions tailored to Turkish users
Quick action button: 'İptal Sayfasını Aç' (opens in new tab)
Quick status update button: 'Aboneliğimi İptal Edildi Olarak İşaretle'
Seeded promotion cards (Öğrenci İndirimleri, Yıllık Ödeme Avantajları, Aile Paketi Geçişleri)
Calculated monthly savings indicator
Claim/Switch plan step-by-step guide

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions like transition: all. Always target specific properties (opacity, transform, color, background-color).
Do NOT center align main text containers; preserve natural left-aligned reading hierarchy.
Every card container MUST have internal padding (p-5 or p-6) to prevent text collision with card borders.
Always ensure contrast ratio meets APCA standards over dark slate backgrounds (#0B0F19, #111827, #1E293B).
The MOCKED tag must be clear, visible, and styled as an informative purple/amber status pill without looking like a destructive system error.
Ensure standard JS component files (.js / .jsx) are used rather than .tsx.
